steps.text: Hey 😊 Classes are over and I've got a little time before work, how's your first day of freedom going?
I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
Putting the shoe on was the hard part
Did you try doing it standing up?
Once
I knew it
I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
Too late, I felt it 😌
Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
Mostly awkward, I'm taking it slowly
Good ❤️
How was your morning?
The professor spent ages explaining something that wasn't even on the right slide
Someone finally told him and he just went 'yes, that's for next week'
Very reassuring
I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
Was there one?
No, just a napkin and disappointment
At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
You don't look that disappointed
I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
You'd better eat something too
Already did
Good, one less person to supervise 😌
You supervising people at work now?
Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
Have a good afternoon
Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.

steps.text: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
It should be
Because this total is different
Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
You tell me
I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
This one?
Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
You could have checked before printing it
You could have checked before writing on every page
Fair enough
Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
Come around here. Show me what you changed
There, that line was included twice
I missed that yesterday
I know. You told me to check my calculation again
And you did
Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
You should have told me
I just did
A little sooner would have saved you some time
Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
I think you've earned that
I'm going to remember you said that

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: Two subjects standing together beside the desk

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.

steps.text: You seem more comfortable in here now
With the work? A little
That wasn't exactly what I meant
Then maybe you should be more specific
The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
Because you always looked busy
And now?
Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
So I'm less intimidating
I didn't say you were intimidating
You just didn't want to come any closer
You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
Some things are hard not to notice
You're doing it again
Doing what?
Looking at me instead of the screen
You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
That isn't an answer
It wasn't meant to be
You really don't make this easy
Make what easy?
Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
Are we still on for tomorrow?
The drink?
Yes, the drink
I said I'd come, didn't I?
You also said you might be tired after work
I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
Seven should be fine
And no spreadsheets
You say that now. If you bring one, I'm leaving you there
You can leave whenever you like
I know, but I'd rather not spend my first evening out hearing about work
I just wanted to make sure you still wanted to go
I do
Good
You look very pleased with yourself
Should I not be?
I didn't say that
Then I'll try not to overdo it
You're not trying very hard

steps.title: HAK//NOTICE
messages: The manager moves closer and initiates a kiss

messages.speaker: player
messages.text: He just kissed {{name:lena}}. My hands have gone cold, and for a second I can't even take in what I'm seeing.

steps.text: Wait... what are you doing?
Sorry. I shouldn't have done that
No, you shouldn't
I'll step back
I have a boyfriend
I know
Then you can't just kiss me like that
You're right
I wasn't expecting that
My bad, your right
I need to get back to work
Of course
And you need to stop looking at me like that
I will try
You should try harder
I will
Should I cancel tomorrow?
No
Are you sure?
I still want to go. I just... I need a minute
Take one
Alone, preferably
Of course
I'll finish the last checks at my desk
You can send it over when you're ready
Yeah. Let me get my phone
After her shift, at the bus stop...
I'm out ❤️ Sorry, I thought I'd be able to text sooner
Did you sort out the spreadsheet?
Yeah, eventually
We started with the wrong printout, so that was a great use of everyone's time 😭
The expensive sandwich deserved a better afternoon
And I was hungry again an hour later, so it didn't even do its job
Heading home now?
Waiting for the bus, unless it decides not to exist again
Is it late?
It says four minutes. It also said four minutes when I got here
At least I found a seat
Long afternoon?
Longer than I expected, yeah
Everything okay?
Yeah, just a lot going round in my head
I need food and a bit of time not looking at numbers
I can talk about something incredibly unimportant
Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
A successful expedition then
And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
Don't sound so surprised
I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
Do you feel like watching something together later?
Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
Exactly that
I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
You make such a convincing offer
Say yes, I've already saved it
Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
Talk to you in a bit
